So often I see questions online about life decisions - "which one should I do?" Of course asking for advice is always good, but I know from my own experience that often the backdrop of the question is the feeling that there is a "right" and a "wrong" decision. So I offer this one thought:

Life is not Zork.

There is never a "right" decision. Whichever direction you go, you are still going to live your life. You are going to meet people, and make friends, and have experiences. All we are doing when we make these decisions is choosing a path, not selecting the strategy to win.

So more than anything, choose the most interesting path. Choose the path that takes you somewhere new. Choose the path that pulls you out of your comfort zone and makes your life richer.

When two roads diverge in a wood, take the one less traveled by, and let it make all the difference.
